rule: Refuse a symlinked leaf with O_NOFOLLOW on every write to an agent-writable path and on any read of existing content that precedes a replace.
Treat a leaf as unsafe if it is a symlink, has st_nlink > 1, or is not a regular file, and apply all three checks to readers as well as writers.
Require the parent directory to resolve to its exact lexical location under the repo root; a no-escape check still lets a symlinked ancestor alias another in-repo directory.
Run the containment guard before any mkdir, open or lock, and apply it to every reader and writer of the class, not just the newest one.
Repeat any check after a blocking wait and anchor the use to an fd captured before it, add every writer guard to that file's readers, and never let a refused read look like an absent one.
When a bug class recurs twice, stop patching instances and add a gate that fails the build on the next instance, since shared helpers alone do not force new call sites through them.
Make the check and the use one operation by descending one path component at a time with fd-relative opens; a guard that later re-resolves a multi-component path guards nothing.
Test a gate against its own stated claim, state its limits explicitly, and treat every stated limit as a lead for the next evasion rather than a boundary.
Wire every new control into what consumers receive and enforce that with a derived parity check, because a hand-maintained parity list only agrees with itself.
Grant an allowlist exemption to a specific call site, count its matches, and fail when the count moves so it cannot silently cover code the reviewer never read.
Guard the first operation that touches the filesystem, and when reviewing an exemption read its reason as an ordering claim and verify that order against the code.
A bug class that was fixed once will be rewritten by people who know it, so encode the check in the tool or its tests rather than relying on anyone remembering the postmortem.
When a fix generalises, apply it to every sibling of the fixed member (all binding forms, all fd-capturing primitives, all operand positions) before stopping.
A gate that scans its own reporting channel needs a narrow, tested distinction between quoting an attack as evidence and performing it, or accurate reporting will get it removed.
Remediation advice a gate prints is part of its contract, so a test must follow that exact instruction and assert the finding clears.
Design any validator over an append-only record with an additive remedy it honours plus fail-closed guards so that remedy cannot retire a live finding.
Scope an exception over an ordered append-only record in every dimension it has, at least which finding, which target, and which position, since an unscoped dimension is the same hole.
If a control must be hedged to stay satisfiable, fix the semantics that make it unsatisfiable instead of shipping the hedge, and never let an eval assert the hedge as correct.
A documented limit is not an implemented one: either implement the bound or make the control's output say plainly which guarantee tier the caller actually has.
Before delegating a manual step, confirm the receiving side has every ref, file, credential and piece of state the step needs, or the instruction is impossible.
For every input a security check trusts, name who can write it; local tracking refs, ambient environment variables and discarded return values are not evidence.
Two redundant guards cannot be proven by reverting one line; revert the whole mechanism or pin each guard separately, and state which line each test actually pins.
When a helper's callers gain a new kind of capability, re-derive the helper's coverage from scratch instead of assuming the old list still spans it.
An eval that can no longer build its own baseline must fail, not skip, because a skipped task leaves the denominator and silently measures nothing.
Before adding a status to a producer, update every reader that classifies by elimination, and require positive evidence for positive claims so unknown values degrade to a warning.
When re-reading state to fix a stale check, also refresh the policy it applies, preferably by letting the component that reads policy at call time make the decision.
Assert the message a refusal prints, not just a nonzero exit, since a missing file, typo or unbound variable also exits nonzero.
When closing a timing window, examine both edges: what was already cached when the pin was taken and what can change between the pin and the last consumer that trusts it.
A revert probe must fail because the deciding path changed, using the real hostile input; tests that reach around the defect via a helper or benign input prove nothing.
Mechanize any claim that every reader or writer was swept as a discovery test that fails on a new unrouted site, with an allowlist whose entries carry reasons.
Pass raw text to the canonical parser rather than pre-splitting it, because whoever splits the input into lines decides the semantics.
A cache validated by coarse metadata (mtime to the second, size) serves stale code to a same-length rewrite; disable it wherever code is mutated and re-run.
A containment probe needs a positive control: a sandbox that cannot run code at all exits nonzero exactly like one that blocked the attack.
